text.insert: Sandbox activity lands in the same tracing fabric as everything else because it introduces no new identity: sandbox operations run under the worker's existing trace anchor, and durable facts keep flowing through the events the

already defines. A kernel container remains the traceable execution envelope around a worker's prompt, tools, agent session, and artifacts; the sandbox is the OS container inside that envelope, not a second trace subject.
The event envelope's identity fields extend to sandbox operations without new vocabulary:
Every sandbox lifecycle call — create, start, stop, delete — and every exec or file transfer executes under the worker state's
with its own span, so token accounting, latency, and failure attribution read from one trace.
stays the owning workflow's, grouping a claim's sandbox activity under the run that dispatched it;
names the command or event that made the operation happen — a tool call, a validation step, a recovery action.

Sandbox lifecycle transitions are operations, not durable state transitions: they increment no revision and mint no event kinds. Where sandbox activity changes durable state — a claim settles, a checkpoint is recorded, a run recovers — the existing events carry the facts, and cancelled claim ids in
double as the record of reaped sandboxes.

props.title: Open call — span and operation naming

text.insert: Event and span naming conventions are being finalized in the current events pass. This page binds sandbox operations to the envelope's identity fields and defers all naming to that pass rather than minting sandbox-specific conventions here.
